decisions.reason: The firm has invested in and publicly presented the semi-hard cheese wheel, and its closeness to the established offer makes it central, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
Despite the spicy cheese being a flavored variation, the firm has publicly committed to it and sunk costs weigh heavily, leading management to persist.
The mild creamy soft cheese was prominently announced at launch and is part of the cheese line, so visible commitment and sunk costs lead management to keep it.
